notes.title: Playtest Ended
notes.content:
I want to thank those that took part in the test.

A lot of feedback has been gathered and noted.

What is clear from the test,

1. The game loop needs more to it.
2. UI and ship UI controls need a rework
3. its not really clear on how to do things. like landing and cargo runs etc
4. alot of work on the flight mechanics.

There is alot more but these come to mind as I write this.
Its clear the game needs to head in a better direction. but also there was alot of positive feedback to.

So stay tuned to the discord or forums for further updates.

Again. Thank you for those that took part.
